id: title:feliperalmeida:clear leaked log context in the stable chunks log test

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a guard against thread-local structlog context leakage between Django test assertions, potentially preventing false-positive log assertions or skipped assertions in the test suite.
review.reason: Adds an explicit `structlog.get_logger().new()` call before a test assertion, resetting the thread-local context. This is a localized maintenance and test reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The broader implementation and complete implementation are unavailable; no test execution results or wider change context are provided. The benefit is inferred rather than demonstrated.
